title: 第1章 伯爵之子第2章 伯爵收藏室
content_zh:
我叫默里·格林，男，未婚，可能是穿越的姿势对了，也可能是老天爷的补偿，原本是九九六上班族的我居然成为一名贵族之子。
站在全身镜前，默里·格林看着眼前陌生的面容，英俊帅气，浅蓝色双眸如同蓝天一般透彻明亮，长黑发，嘴角上扬，一股青春气息扑面而来，这就是他现在的身体。
‘我要是这副面容回到那个世界，女朋友一天不会少于两个。’
一旁的男仆伸手为他整理衣领，让其耸立起来，使得默里的脖子不由自主伸直，昂首挺胸，搭配着一整套绣金贵族袍，好一副英俊贵公子模样。
“小少爷，您看这样搭配是否合适。”
“不错。”
默里·格林点头微笑道，然后抬手在自己胸腹上轻轻按压一下，发现疼痛感不重。
一个多星期前，也是他原来到这个世界的时间。
默里·格林和大哥出门游玩打猎，突遇魔兽群，遭受魔兽袭击的默里不慎落马。
还被马蹄踏中，身受重伤，命悬一线，甚至心跳都停止过一段时间。
“啊！在床上躺一个多星期，除了还有一些疼痛外，差不多痊愈，今天我就不一个人在卧室用餐，去大厅陪父母和大哥一起用餐。”
经过一个星期的融合，他认为是时候出去适应这个世界了。
听到他的安排，男仆满脸笑容的说道。
“伯爵大人和伯爵夫人绝对会很高兴您出现在餐厅，为了少爷能够早日康复，夫人可是亲自出手，为少爷炼制了几瓶治疗魔药啊！”
“嗯，断了这么多根骨头，一个星期就能让我痊愈，不愧是母亲大人炼制的魔药。”
说到这，默里.格林的双眸中显露出兴奋与狂热的目光，不同于他原来的科技世界，这个世界存在着战气与魔法，是一个拥有龙与魔兽的奇妙世界。
他的母亲，伯爵夫人就是一名神奇的魔法师，他的父亲，伟大的伯爵大人，是一名战士，他的大哥，也是一名战士。
而他本人，虽然现在是一个普通人，但未来可期。
在男仆的服侍下，默里.格林洗漱完毕，便来到自己的床头柜前，拉开抽屉，一个精致的木盒映入眼帘。
打开木盒，只见一支装满绿色液体的试管状玻璃瓶正躺在最角落，瓶中液体隐隐放光，一看就不是寻常物品。

“治疗魔药，最后一支了。”
口中呢喃一句，默里毫不犹豫的拿起绿色的治疗魔药，取下塞子，一股草木清香从中溢出，闻着这股清香，心旷神怡，感觉自己身体的疼痛都减轻不少。
魔药入口，初尝如同清水，喝下后却有股回甘，接着默里就感受到一股温热气息出现在自己肚子中，如同春风般吹拂受伤的地方，疼痛感快速消散。
虽然不是第一次喝治疗魔药，但每次喝完后的效果都让默里惊奇不已，太他喵的神奇了，这让默里·格林对魔法和战气更加好奇。
走出房间，沿着昏暗的走廊，来到大厅，大厅最后方挂着七副人像，是格林家族的历代家主。
content_en:
My name is Murray Green, male, and unmarried. Maybe because I traveled through time in the right way, or maybe it was God’s compensation, I was originally a 996 office worker and became the son of a nobleman.
Standing in front of the full-length mirror, Murray Green looked at the unfamiliar face in front of him. He was handsome and handsome, with light blue eyes as clear and bright as the blue sky. He had long black hair, and the corners of his mouth were raised. A youthful atmosphere hit his face. This was his current body.
‘If I were to return to that world with this face, I would have no less than two girlfriends a day. ’
The valet on the side stretched out his hand to straighten his collar, making it stand up, causing Murray's neck to straighten involuntarily, his head held high, and he wore a set of gold-embroidered aristocratic robes, making him look like a handsome nobleman.
"Young Master, do you think this combination is suitable?"
"Not bad."
Murray Green nodded and smiled, then raised his hand and pressed gently on his chest and abdomen, and found that the pain was not severe.
More than a week ago, it was also the time when he originally came to this world.
Murray Green and his eldest brother went out hunting and suddenly encountered a group of monsters. Murray was attacked by monsters and accidentally fell off his horse.
He was also trampled by a horse's hoof and was seriously injured. His life hung on a thread, and his heartbeat even stopped for a while.
"Ah! I have been lying in bed for more than a week. Except for some pain, I have almost recovered. Today I will not eat alone in the bedroom. I will go to the hall to eat with my parents and eldest brother."
After a week of integration, he decided it was time to go out and adapt to the world.
After hearing his arrangement, the manservant said with a smile on his face.
"The Earl and the Countess will definitely be happy for you to show up in the restaurant. In order for the young master to recover as soon as possible, the lady took it upon herself to refine several bottles of healing potion for the young master!"
"Well, with so many broken bones, I can recover within a week. It is indeed a magic potion made by my mother."
Speaking of this, Murray Green's eyes showed excitement and fanaticism. Different from his original technological world, this world contained fighting spirit and magic. It was a wonderful world with dragons and magical beasts.
His mother, the Countess, was a magical magician, his father, the great Earl, was a warrior, and his eldest brother was also a warrior.
As for him, although he is an ordinary person now, he has a promising future.
Under the service of the valet, Murray Green finished washing, then went to his bedside table, opened the drawer, and a delicate wooden box came into view.
Opening the wooden box, I saw a test tube-shaped glass bottle filled with green liquid lying in the corner. The liquid in the bottle was faintly glowing. At first glance, it was not an ordinary item.
"The healing potion is the last one."
With a murmur in his mouth, Murray picked up the green healing potion without hesitation and took off the stopper. A scent of grass and trees overflowed from it. Smelling this scent, he felt relaxed and happy, and felt that the pain in his body was relieved a lot.
When the potion entered the mouth, it tasted like water at first, but after drinking it, there was a sweet aftertaste. Then Murray felt a warm breath appear in his stomach, blowing on the injured area like a spring breeze, and the pain quickly dissipated.
Although this was not the first time he drank the healing potion, Murray was always amazed by the effects after drinking it. It was so damn magical, which made Murray Green even more curious about magic and fighting spirit.
Walk out of the room and follow the dim corridor to the hall. At the end of the hall hang seven portraits, representing the successive heads of the Green family.
